highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 moves to Skia m158 while preserving the existing managed binding surface.
highlights_body: The new package line also corrects calling-convention metadata for source-generated native imports. HarfBuzz remains at native version 14.4.0; its package revision advances without an engine upgrade.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without adding managed APIs or C bridge exports. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

LibraryImport declarations now specify the same cdecl convention as the existing DllImport paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and the extension bindings. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.
